Results.ReviewText: Drastically reduced cooking time  I like to cook with high and controlled heat on a BBQ. Weber Spirit e325 does the job. And it saves me space in my patio when not in use. Weber happily and quickly replaced a side panel that was bent. Good customer care!
Results.Title: Compact and Powerful

Results.ReviewText: For cooking I give 5 stars, but we move our grill every time we use it.  This grill is heavy and there is no easy way to roll it on the wheels. There's no handle and when I used the collapsible shelf to move it the shelf came off its hinge pins. I removed the factory wheels and feet and replaced with 4 casters and added a handle on each side of the cook box. Now it's easy to move around.
Results.Title: Nice grill but hard to move around

Results.ReviewText: This is my 2nd Weber grill, the first lasting over 12 years. I have owned many different brands over the years, Weber is the only grill that has lasted more than 5 years. They grates are very durable and the grill has good heat distribution for even cooking. (Other grills seem to be hot in back and cold in front).
Results.Title: Will only buy a Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill overall. Simple assembly process, excellent quality across the board.
Results.Title: Thumbs Up!

Results.ReviewText:
I love my Webber Spirits. This is the third one I’ve owned. They’re easy to assemble out of package on my own (small female).  The last Spirit I purchased was 10 years ago, so they last -
regular, weekly use. Unfortunately, this new Spirit E-325 gets 4-stars (4.5, if possible) because the cabinet of the grill is a downgrade from previous versions. I loathe that there are two plastic wheels vs the four casters I had before that allowed me to easily pull out the grill, move it around, and put it back in its corner after use. The side table material/finish is an upgrade, but they are tougher to pull up and down, especially having to use one as a handle to bring the grill out and put it away since it doesn’t easily wheel around. There is no longer a weight sensor for the propane tank. The cabinet itself is not as sturdy, feels flimsy. The grill did not come with a cover. The best improvement is the igniter - super easy to use. I love the sear option. In summary, the grill is awesome, as always, but the cabinet has been downgraded in function.
Results.Title: Grill-great. Cabinet-not so great.

Results.ReviewText: Works great. I wish it had a panel covering the back of the LP tank area.

Results.ReviewText: I only had the grill for one month when the regular blew. I have been waiting for a replacement part for it for 4 weeks. I am very sorry I brought this grill and will never buy a weber again.
Results.Title: Don't buy a Weber grill

Results.ReviewText:
I finally gave up my 24 year old Weber Spirit! 
I purchased another, however, I dislike there are no casters on 2 legs causing me to drag the grill away from the wall instead of simply rolling it. I also feel the legs sitting bare will prompt early corrosion as I often hose off the are it's used in.
The side table that flips up is flimsy and I don't exactly trust it's design. My " elderly" Weber's side table was made of a hard plastic, coriander type material that latched solidly and cleaned up amazingly.
Too bad Weber compromised in placing lesser quality in the areas I mentioned. But I am a Weber fan so I am going to give this a go. The 3 burners ignite individually and are super responsive to light. The grill grids clean up easily and it cooks food evenly.
Results.Title: It's a " drag" but cooks well.

Results.ReviewText: Recently replaced my grill with a Weber. Best decision ever! The Weber is super easy to clean, a breeze to start, cooks evenly and the BBQ cover ( also Weber) is not daunting to get back on even in wind. I am not an experienced griller and usually my husband does this. This grill has made me more motivated to use it.
Results.Title: Best BBQ I ever owned

Results.ReviewText: This my second Weber grill and can't be gappier with my choice Spirit E-325, all 3 burners heat quickly and most important evenly
Results.Title: Weber"s the Best

Results.ReviewText: Be careful when assembling to make sure the propane hose is not in a bind.  Undue angled stress of the hose at the regulator can damage the hose to regulator connection and cause it to leak. You may have to rotate the propane tank 180 degrees to unbind the hose.
Results.Title: Do not put propane hose in a bind!

Results.ReviewText: This grill is not nearly as good as the previous Weber it replaced.  It looks and feels cheaper.  For example it no longer has a back panel on the stand allowing rain to fill the grease dish.  The new ignition system is difficult to use and inconsistent.  Definitely not an improvement over the last.  On a positive note it still cooks as well.
Results.Title: Not your father’s grill

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback. Your satisfaction is very important to us. So sorry to hear about the issue lighting the grill. We are here to help. Please look for our email outreach soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: I like the grill's performance.  The heat is even across the burners.  My only issue, and it is a big one is the process of lighting the grill.  You have to hold the knob in for a few seconds and then turn it left to ignite.  The problem is you can't tell right away if the burner is lit.  You can't see the flame or hear it.  You could end up with a burner that is not lit and passing propane into the grill.  I am very careful but my concern is with another family member lighting the grill and not realizing the burners didn't light.  I have had to try a couple of times to get the middle burner lit.  Cooks great but I probably wouldn't buy it if I had realized this.
Results.Title: Cooks great-safety concern

Results.ReviewText: My last Weber grill lasted me 22 years. That is the reason ( among others) that I  decided to purchase another Weber. Although you can get grills cheaper, this is a classic example of you get what you pay for. The new grill that I purchased is fantastic. The sear zone is  great for steaks and the temperature control works great. Do yourself a favor, pay the extra money for the quality of a Weber! You will never go back
